verdict.rationale: Google Cloud is a platform that could plausibly let its agent tooling (e.g., Vertex AI) consume external MCP servers, so the axis applies. However, the pack shows only the server side: Google publishes MCP servers (the Cloud Run MCP server and MCP Toolbox for Databases) that other clients connect to. Nothing shows Google Cloud itself plugging in third-party MCP servers as a client, and the Vertex AI agentic claims never mention MCP client support.
